project.description:
Astar is a web3 collective building products that bring users onchain. It operates as a multichain ecosystem that coordinates products and contributors through a shared economic and governance framework.
Astar Network, Astar's own blockchain, anchors the Collective's governance and runs dApp Staking, while its products launch wherever their users already are. Product development is guided by the Astar Stack, the suite of products Astar is building to bring real financial activity onchain.
The first product in the Astar Stack is Astar Fi (astarfi.com), an onchain personal finance manager incubated by Astar Collective. It brings your onchain net worth into one clear view, then lets you earn and invest from the same place. Astar Fi is multichain, starting with Ethereum and Base.
ASTR is the economic and governance token of the Astar ecosystem, used on Astar Network for staking and onchain governance.
